title: ToolDeclaration v1
description: Every tool needs an explicit declaration: schema, capability requirements, risk classification, timeout, output limit, approval policy. Never add a tool with only a Python function and a model description. Risk levels are declared by the tool — never provided or overridden by the LLM.

capabilities.description: Capabilities required to execute, e.g. database.read.orders, notes.write, browser.read.

PolicyDecision.description: Formalized risk/approval verdict. Inputs: tool, user/session identity, capabilities, resource, arguments, risk, environment, budget.
